⚽️ IT’S MATCHDAY!!! ⚽️

The Town boys are on the road to take on Sandbach United. It’s always a tough place to go so your support could be vital! 

🏟️: Sandbach Community Football Centre, Hind Heath Road, CW11 3LZ
🎟️: £6 Adults, £5 concessions, £2 U16’s

Don’t miss it! 

#UpTheTown

Matchday and it’s a big one against Stafford Town, both teams have been in or around the play offs in the last two seasons so will be an intriguing affair this afternoon, get down and support The Bach!

Adults £6, Concessions £5, U16 £2 https://t.co/YGyaiCWMtd
As you wait for kick off we are pleased to announce the continued sponsorship of Captain Robbie Hatton. Thank you for your support. https://t.co/MGRNDrQQ4y

Your Stafford team to take on Sandbach. 

One change to the 11 from Tuesday as Tom Efford makes his first competitive start, in for Jones. Doug Hughes comes in on the bench. 

#UpTheTown https://t.co/VDbQOhd5p1
